=========================================
newline after a comment in statements
=========================================
( { a /*c*/
} )
---
(program
  (list
    (block
      (statements
        (statement) (comment) (newline)
      )
    )
  )
)

=========================================
comment after statements
=========================================
( { a /*c*/ } )
---
(program
  (list
    (block
      (statements
        (statement)
      )
      (comment)
    )
  )
)

=========================================
bang after statements
=========================================
( a ! { b } )
---
(program
  (list
    (statements
      (statement)
    )
    (bang)
    (block
      (statements
        (statement)
      )
    )
  )
)
